info.title: Atlas Hiring API
info.description: Versioned REST API. All responses use the envelope `{ data }` or `{ error: { code, message, details, requestId } }`. Request schemas are generated from the server-side validators. State-changing requests from browsers must include a same-origin `Origin` header (CSRF protection). Organisation-scoped endpoints take the organisation slug in `x-atlas-org`; access is always verified against the caller's membership.
